raw_segments.text: It can never be the interest of the unproductive class to oppress the other two classes.
It is the surplus produce of the land, or what remains after deducting the maintenance,
first of the cultivators, and afterwards of the proprietors, that maintains and employs
The greater this surplus, the greater must likewise be the maintenance and employment
